    Realizations go to distinguished triangles (Proposition 2.3, Step 4) #

    The shadow functor Γ is fully faithful on the objects e₀ X of K(Q) with X ∈ K(Q₀) whose image in K(Rep k I) is K-injective; these objects are stable under ⟦1⟧ and cones. The realization functor sends X-free objects of C_J to such objects, and Γ sends the triangle of a realization to the triangle of the short exact sequence ρA → ρB → ρC in the derived category. So realizations between X-free objects go to distinguished triangles; in general the X-parts split off as a direct sum with a split triangle.
